resumeText: Kwame Mensah is an LLM Engineer at Horizon AI Labs with three years of experience. He builds Python services that call OpenAI and Anthropic APIs, crafting prompts and wiring RAG-style retrieval flows with LangChain to answer questions from internal documents. He previously worked as a software engineer at Tema Tech Group building API services. His focus is production LLM applications, and he is actively learning vector databases.
